text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond seems unusually nervous before the Kyoto Daishoten, but she claims she's fine.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She says the reason her running has been off is because she's been feeling obligated to run like an illustrious runner would.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, becoming an illustrious runner is her own dream. That acknowledgement reminds her of the joy of running for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Satono Diamond promises to run her own way and heads off for the race.
